note: The selection page shown when a group is longer than GROUP_TILES: the arrows move it (ui "group_page").
The win panel's close press: the panel stays shut for the rest of the page's life.
The shop per hero kind: pinned item indices, and the item whose recipe tree is shown.
A hero's picture: its icon until its model has loaded, then the 3D preview (the widget's model kind, which the page
switches itself when the model arrives, so this part of the tree stays the same).
The hero kind a shop press belongs to: pins and the recipe pick are kept per kind, so they persist per hero.
The recipe tree of an item: its own line, then each component below it (four levels down at most).
One page of GROUP_TILES tiles, as StarCraft II shows a group: the count of the whole selection, then the pager.

hero_group is defined with the hero tables below; the lobby rules reach it through here.
A roster hero no seat holds (or any hero, when duplicates are allowed) that the mode pool allows; nil when none is free.
Whether the Random button has a hero to pick. Reads no randomness, so building the tree never changes the draw.
The seats before the match starts, after each lobby change: whether each seat is ready and which hero's model it
will play. The page parses a readied hero's model now, so the match starts without waiting on the download.
One lobby action on the shared state: the rules of the hero select. Slots are 0-based in the calls, as the sim counts.
The sender: a joined page's key rides on its action (applyPeerAction); the host's own presses use OWNER.
An empty hero is the Random button: the press picks a free hero here, so the lobby tree does not change per tick.
The tone of a seat's state: open (faint), seated but not ready (warn), ready (ok). owner_text and readySuffix say the same in words.
6.88g hero rows (scenarios/moba/heroes_688g.tsv, UnitBalance, hundredths): display name, then base and gain per
level of strength, agility and intelligence.
The primary attribute group (1 strength, 2 agility, 3 intelligence) is the primary column of heroes_688g.tsv (6.88g
UnitBalance), copied here because the mod VM reads no files. A hero without a row falls back to its kind's primary (game.unit_kinds), so every roster hero should have one.
Owner placements for the four heroes 6.88g does not carry (heroes_688g.tsv: hero-not-in-688g.tsv). Not 6.88g values.
The 6.88g primary (heroes_688g.tsv column 4, 0 strength, 1 agility, 2 intelligence) plus 1 for this table.
Every roster hero should have a row here (1, 2 or 3); hero_group falls back to the kind's primary for one without.
6.88g hero-base.tsv primary text (unit.ini): abaddon STR, furion INT, visage INT.
Not in 6.88g: primaries from Dota 2 npc_dota_hero_<hero>.txt AttributePrimary at SteamDatabase 282fad29 (same value as attr_rules.txt).
Dota 2 DOTA_ATTRIBUTE_ALL (universal) stays out, like the TSV=3 heroes: marci, pangolier, snapfire, void_spirit.
A hero's group is its HERO_PRIMARY row (1, 2 or 3) when it has one. Without a row it is the primary of its unit kind
(game.unit_kinds: 0 strength, 1 agility, 2 intelligence) plus 1. A universal kind (3) has no column of its own, and a
kind with no attr line has no primary; both fall back to ATTR_FALLBACK_GROUP, the strength column.
The acronym behind each hero's icon, from hero_acronyms.lua (generated by tools/gen-hero-acronyms.mjs; the mod VM has
no string library, so the table is precomputed). The heroAcronyms override in moba_ui.json wins over it.
The largest base of each attribute over the roster: the full scale of the stat bars.
One seat in the top strip: its head, its hero and its claim or leave button. Seats in the strip never pick.
A hero tile in the centre grid: a portrait with its acronym as the badge and no name under it (the name is on the
right card and the seat strip). Only a seat's own tile picks, and only while that seat is unready.
The centre grid: one labelled column per primary attribute (Strength, Agility, Intelligence) in a regions container
(side by side on a wide screen, swipeable on a narrow one), each holding its portraits sized to fit. Every hero has
one of the three groups; hero_group gives each roster hero one (its HERO_PRIMARY row, else its kind's primary, else strength).
One team's strip: its name, how many seats are filled, and its seats.
The right card for the local seat: its hero's portrait, name, stat bars and roles, then Lock In and Random.
The button names no hero: the press picks a free one (lobby_act), so the tree is the same from tick to tick.
The bottom bar's team composition: each team's picked heroes.
The host's game-mode buttons (6.88g: the host types -ar, -aa ... in the first 15 s). A set button reads "[x]".
The lobby panel alone, on setup and after each lobby call: the page does not tick the sim until the match starts, so the
lobby cannot wait for the timer's first run. The other panels stay with the timer, so the first widget event of each of
them is the same as before.
A peer that closes in the lobby gives its seat back (the host reports it; a started match is leave.lua's).
Every REFRESH_TICKS ticks from the first tick: the panels that changed go out again.
